name: terraform-azure
description: Create Terraform infrastructure for Azure deployment
request_pattern: Create Terraform configuration for Azure. Deploy: ${resources}. Include: resource group, virtual network with subnets, network security groups, managed identity, Azure Key Vault for secrets, variables.tf, outputs.tf, and a README. Use ${azure_region} region.

variables.resources: App Service with Azure SQL Database, Azure Cache for Redis, and Storage Account
